Validates that work items (e.g. backlog items) trace to goals. Outputs alignment
score (0-100).

Alignment checks:
  - Goal alignment: work items with goal_refs vs goals
  - Alignment score: 0-100 (goal coverage; BLI-781)
  - Use --dashboard for a comprehensive alignment view (BLI-782)
  - Use --gaps to list only items without goal alignment
  - Use --goal to focus on a specific goal
  - Use --score to output only the alignment score (for scripting)

  Check alignment
  zqk system align
  Alignment dashboard
  zqk system align --dashboard
  Show alignment gaps only
  zqk system align --gaps
  Alignment for a specific goal
  zqk system align --goal GOAL-001
  Score only (scripting)
  zqk system align --score

Usage:
  zqk system align [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dashboard               Show comprehensive alignment dashboard (score, goal coverage, and metrics)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --gaps                    Show only items without goal alignment
      --goal string             Filter by goal ID (e.g. GOAL-001); show only work aligned to this goal
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --score                   Output only the alignment score (0-100) for scripting/dashboards
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
